# Planora 1.8.2
## 中文
- Mac 横向切换改为原生 NSSegmentedControl，采用大尺寸胶囊、新版尺寸参数，以及 macOS 27 的 valueSelection 角色；点击、按压、拖动与键盘行为由系统控制，不叠加自绘玻璃滑块。 - 成绩、课程分区、周/月日历和任务状态使用统一原生控件。macOS 26 使用兼容系统参数，不调用 27 专属 API。 - 左上角侧栏/新建操作改为原生工具栏分组，移除额外标题栏附件和固定留白。 - 使用统一窗口工具栏与系统全屏常显参数，减少全屏悬停时的布局变化。iPhone/iPad 侧栏和原有分段控件保持不变。
Mac 安装包为临时签名，未经过 Apple 公证。全屏悬停流畅度仍需在用户的实际设备上验证。
## English
- Mac mode switches use native NSSegmentedControl with large capsule controls, modern size metrics and the macOS 27 valueSelection role. The system handles click, press, drag and keyboard interaction without custom glass thumb overlays. - Grades, course sections, week/month calendar and task status share the native control. macOS 26 uses compatible system settings without calling 27-only APIs. - Sidebar/new-task actions use a native toolbar group instead of a fixed-width title-bar accessory. - Unified window toolbars remain visible in full screen using the system API, reducing hover-related layout changes. iPhone/iPad sidebars and segmented pickers are unchanged.
The Mac package is ad-hoc signed, not Apple-notarized. Full-screen hover smoothness still requires verification on the user's actual device.

# Planora 1.8.1
## 中文
- Mac 常驻菜单栏图标采用应用图标的交错圆角任务条轮廓，去除背景并跟随系统深浅配色。 - 未完成任务在截止前 24 小时及逾期时自动显示高优先级；详情标注“自动”，保留原手动优先级，不修改学校端数据。 - iOS、iPadOS 与 macOS 的任务详情可点击课程行进入相应课程。
- 同步完成标题改为快速/完整同步完成，摘要显示本次读取课程、单元、消息及课次，不再混用本地课程与单元总数。 - 快速同步仅显示实际执行的 7 项步骤；单元显示“未重新扫描”，不再暗示已读取全部内容。 - 已有任务计数改为“刷新已有任务”，避免将每次重新读取都描述成内容发生变化。 - 出勤区分“未读取”和“未记录”，不再显示误导性的零；标签明确为本次同步周出勤，区别于首页最近 7 天。 - 连接页增加同步方式与上次完整同步时间，更新中英日文案。
Mac 包为临时签名，未经过 Apple 公证。真实账户同步和实际旧版升级仍需用户验证。
## English
- The Mac menu-bar template icon uses Planora's alternating rounded task bars without a background and follows system appearance. - Incomplete tasks become visually high priority within 24 hours of their deadline or when overdue. Details identify automatic priority; manual values and school data remain unchanged. - Task details link directly to the associated course on iOS, iPadOS and macOS.
- Completion titles distinguish quick and full sync. Results show records read in this scan rather than local course/unit totals. - Quick sync shows its seven executed steps; units are marked Not Rescanned. - Existing task counts now say Tasks Refreshed rather than implying every reread changed the content. - Attendance distinguishes Not Read from Not Recorded instead of displaying zero. The label identifies the synced week, separate from Home's seven-day window. - Connection details show the latest sync mode and last full sync time. Chinese, English and Japanese labels are updated.
The Mac package is ad-hoc signed, not Apple-notarized. Real-account syncing and real-device upgrades still require user verification.

# Planora 1.8
## 中文
- 首页出勤改为最近 7 天，不再将历史课次混入当前出勤率；出勤详情默认本周，仍可查看历史周。 - 新增快速同步与完整同步。快速同步读取全局任务列表、当前消息和当周课表；完整同步补齐课程任务、教师、单元及历史消息。首次连接仍为完整同步。 - 自动同步改为前台最多每 15 分钟一次，每 24 小时安排完整同步，减少重复扫描。快速扫描保留已有课程单元，不把未扫描项目当作删除。 - Mac 新增常驻菜单栏入口，透明背景的任务栏图标使用系统模板配色。关闭主窗口后仍可查看近期任务、手动同步、重新打开应用；退出 Planora 才完全结束。 - 更新中英日帮助说明与同步策略回归测试。
Mac 包使用临时签名，未经过 Apple 公证。真实账户读取与旧版实际升级仍需用户验证。未导入的课次不能纳入最近 7 天统计。常驻不代表关闭窗口后持续进行后台同步，也不会自动加入登录启动项。
## English
- Home attendance now covers the last 7 days. Details defaults to the current week while keeping historical week selection. - Added Quick Sync and Full Sync. Quick refreshes global task lists, current messages and this week's timetable. Full also reads course tasks, teachers, units and message history. Initial connections remain full scans. - Automatic sync runs only while active, at most every 15 minutes, with a full refresh every 24 hours. Partial scans preserve existing units. - Added a resident Mac menu-bar entry with a transparent system-template task-bar icon. Access pending tasks, manual sync and the main window after closing it. Quit Planora to exit. - Updated Chinese, English and Japanese help and added sync-policy regression tests.
The Mac distribution is ad-hoc signed, not Apple-notarized. Real-account scans and upgrades require user verification. Unsynced lessons cannot be included in the seven-day rate. Menu-bar residency does not guarantee continuous background sync after closing windows or enable login startup.

# Planora 1.7.8
## 中文 - 成绩新增系统分段控件：Mac 和 iPad 首页可切换数字与按时间排列的横向柱状图，课程成绩可切换数字、柱状图与折线图；不同学科以不同颜色区分。iPhone 首页不增加此切换。 - 出勤同步新增独立项目，优先读取 ManageBac 时间表右侧的课堂出勤汇总，逐节课状态作为补充；首页与课程页均可查看出勤。更新后请重新同步一次。 - 修正首页出勤率与单周日期混用的问题。任务详情的分数显示不变。 - Mac 与 iOS 构建及成绩、出勤解析测试通过。真实学校页面的出勤汇总仍需使用者验证。 - 保留 Vendor/Sparkle、签名更新源和带隐藏背景文件夹的 DMG。
## English - Added a system segmented control for grades. On Mac and iPad, Home switches between numbers and a chronological, horizontally scrolling bar chart; Course grades offer numbers, bars, and lines. Subjects use distinct colors. The iPhone Home screen has no new switch. - Attendance is now a separate sync item. Planora prefers the classroom attendance overview in ManageBac timetable Details, with per-lesson states as a fallback. Attendance is accessible from Home and Courses. Sync again after updating. - Removed a misleading single-week date beside the overall Home attendance rate. Task detail grades are unchanged. - Mac and iOS builds and focused grade/attendance parsing tests passed. Live school-page attendance still needs user validation. - Includes vendored Sparkle, a signed update feed, and a DMG with an embedded hidden background folder.
The macOS app is ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized. macOS 应用使用临时签名，未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

# Planora 1.7.7
## 中文 - 新增课堂出勤：Mac 侧栏位于课程与消息之间，首页位于学习进度下方；iPhone、iPad 可从首页进入。 - 同步 ManageBac 当前课表周的出勤状态，按已同步的周查看课程明细。区分出席、迟到、缺席和未记录，不将班主任点名统计混入课堂出勤。 - 出勤率为（出席＋迟到）除以已记录课次，未记录不计入分母。更新后请同步一次 ManageBac。 - 已通过 Mac、iOS 构建和课表读取、重复同步测试；真实学校页面的出勤读取结果尚待用户验证，不代表已导入全学期历史。 - 保留 Vendor/Sparkle 和签名更新源；DMG 内置隐藏背景文件夹和 Finder 背景配置。
## English - Added classroom attendance between Courses and Messages in the Mac sidebar, and below Learning Progress on the Home screen. Available from Home on iPhone and iPad too. - Reads attendance from the current ManageBac timetable week and displays previously synced weeks. Present, late, absent and unrecorded lessons remain distinct; homeroom totals are not mixed with classroom attendance. - Attendance rate is (present + late) / recorded lessons. Unrecorded lessons are excluded. Sync ManageBac once after updating. - Mac and iOS builds and focused timetable/import tests passed. Live school-page extraction still needs user validation; full-term history is not automatically imported. - Includes vendored Sparkle, a signed update feed, and an embedded hidden DMG background with Finder metadata.
The macOS app is ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized. macOS 应用使用临时签名，未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

# Planora 1.7.6
## 中文
- 修正 Mac 侧栏图标的布局方式，针对首次启动及台前调度切回应用时图标消失的问题，改为独立、固定尺寸的图标行。 - 修复 ManageBac 截止时间被日期整理代码重置为凌晨 12:00 的问题，保留导入的时分和时区对应的时间点。更新后请同步一次 ManageBac，恢复此前已被重置的截止时间。 - 提醒、重复和批量操作改用 Mac 原生分组表单，内容从顶部排列，修正大片空白和控件挤在中央的问题。 - DMG 继续使用 Finder 原生背景设置，图片保存在映像内部的 `.background/installation.png`，并保留中英文安装说明。 - 保留 Mac 专用的 Vendor/Sparkle 更新框架，提供签名更新归档和 appcast。iPhone/iPad 不包含 Sparkle。
验证范围：Mac 通用版本及 iOS Simulator 构建、截止时间针对性回归测试、DMG 内容和更新签名检查。台前调度和新设备的最终显示效果由用户验证，本次不进行长时间真机测试。
Mac 应用使用临时签名，未经过 Apple Developer ID 签名或公证；Sparkle 更新签名用于验证更新来源。
## English
- Replaced automatic sidebar label icons with independently laid-out, fixed-size symbols to address missing icons at first launch and when returning through Stage Manager. - Fixed date normalization resetting ManageBac deadlines to midnight. Imported times now retain their exact timestamp across time zones. Sync ManageBac once after updating to restore previously reset deadlines. - Switched reminder, recurrence, and bulk-action editors to native Mac grouped forms with top-aligned content. - Retained Finder-native DMG background settings and the embedded `.background/installation.png`, with bilingual installation instructions. - Retained the Mac-only vendored Sparkle framework, signed update archive, and appcast. Sparkle is not included in iPhone/iPad builds.
Validation covers the universal Mac and iOS Simulator builds, focused deadline regression tests, DMG contents, and update signatures. Final Stage Manager and new-device appearance checks are left to the user; no extended physical-device testing was performed.
The Mac app is ad-hoc signed, without Apple Developer ID signing or notarization. Sparkle signatures verify the update source.
